actual.value: Cells are alive and have specialised parts.

actual.last:
Another way: plainer words
Simple lesson

In simpler words: Every living thing is made of cells; a cell is the smallest unit that is alive, and its parts have distinct jobs.

The key fact is that the cell is the smallest thing that counts as alive.
